status: Design and stop rules only; not a submitted Slurm job or a frozen scientific confirmation protocol.

first_stage.purpose: Reject a negligible timing mechanism cheaply and measure actual resources.
first_stage.planning_cap: One L4, 30 minutes model runtime for initial profiling; no training, no paid procurement. Environment preparation is separate and must be bounded. Do not automatically repeat a failed job.
first_stage.data: Development-only chronological observations, retaining episode resets; choose and hash trajectories before collecting comparison results. No scientific holdout is selected yet.
measure: camera preprocessing + transfer + model + action postprocessing wall time
CUDA timing after warmup, same idle allocation
retained visual tokens and controller history state
repeated observation-level timing to separate state variation from jitter
delivery steps ceil(latency_seconds*20), median and tail errors of fixed-median approximation
peak allocated/reserved VRAM and CPU RSS
gates: Unpruned implementation agrees with native model path within declared numerical tolerance; document exact agreement where obtained.
No claim of under-22-GiB fit until measured; stop on insufficient resources.
If all substantive runtime variation is noise or timing intervention leaves delivery steps unchanged, do not advance this first deployment branch.
Freeze the closed-loop cohort, endpoints and uncertainty analysis only after timing feasibility and closest-prior-art checks, before task outcomes.

required_controls: Full model with fixed calibrated timing
Compressed model with the same timing intervention
Compressed model with measured/calibrated state-dependent timing
Fixed-token-budget compression at a matched compute range
closed_loop_outline.primary_candidate: Paired task success effect of changing the timing model for the adaptive policy. Exact confirmatory endpoint and margin remain to be registered before outcomes.
closed_loop_outline.counterfactual_limit: A full model run at an artificially fast simulator clock is a causal diagnostic, never a claimed deployable speedup.

scale_planning.formula: n approximately (z_.975 + z_.8)^2 * q / effect^2 for one paired binary contrast under local approximation
scale_planning.assumptions: Independent paired episodes, two-sided 5% level and 80% power; q is discordance. Does NOT account for task clustering, multiplicity, interaction variance or model replication. Not an exact power calculation.
scale_planning.time_note: 30–120 seconds per rollout are unmeasured scenarios, not a quote or allocation request. Profile before committing compute. A 10–20-episode smoke test is not evidence of a five-point effect.
